llm_response.reason: The website mimics the official Floris van Bommel brand but uses a suspicious, unofficial domain. It displays urgency tactics ('Hot sale', '100% safe shopping'), vague or non-existent company information, inadequate contact details, and an uncharacteristically large product assortment. These factors match several scam indicators: #1 (urgency & unusually low/free offers), #4 (non-existent company info), #5 (product handling deviation), #16 (mimics legitimate design).
